Good to Know

Q & A

How do I RSVP?

Tap RSVP anywhere on this page to open our short form and let us know if you’ll be joining us. Kindly respond by September 20, 2026.

When should I RSVP by?

Please send your response by September 20, 2026 so we can plan for you with care.

Where should I park?

At the Diyanet Center — there is ample parking in the underground garage.
At the dinner — free parking is available around the apartment complex.

What should I wear?

To match our celebration, guests from the groom’s side are warmly invited to wear:
Gentlemen — a cream, off-white or white kurta.
Ladies — a kurta in baby blue, light pink or light pistachio green.
Bride’s side colours — to be shared soon, in shā’ Allāh.

Who can I contact with questions?

We’d love to help:
Groom’s side — Ahsan, (828) 781-5040.
Bride’s side — Maha, (219) 765-9097.
